mutations.name: AT-218: the tombstone check trusts an entry's mere PRESENCE instead of resolving its moved_to -- a lying tombstone would silently pass
a bare kills name resolves against the WHOLE tests tree instead of the spec's own declared tests scope
mutations.old:
name = _bare(nodeid)
    return any(_defines(f, name) for f in scope)
mutations.new:
name = _bare(nodeid)
    return any(_defines(f, name) for f in root.joinpath("tests").rglob("*.py"))
